newsitem.title: FRANCE: SWIMMING-POLL STEALS THE SHOW FROM PANKRATOV.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-POLL STEALS THE SHOW FROM PANKRATOV.

text.p: Costa Rica's Claudia Poll stole the show from Russian Denis Pankratov at the Canet international swimming meeting on Sunday.
The Olympic 200 metres freestyle champion clocked two world bests of the season over the weekend,1:58.18 in her favourite event and 4:10.56 in the 400 metre.
The results were all the more impressive as Poll had only trained for four weeks in 50-metre pools after dominating the short-course season.

After badly missing an attempt at his own 200 metres butterfly world mark on Saturday, Pankratov decided not to take part in Sunday's 100 metres in order to return to Russia to prepare for the European championships in Seville in August.
The proximity of the championships hampered the meeting as most European swimmers seemed to be concentrating on the big event and had below-par performances.
